subject: CORRECTION to 8d3e567b and 423cd7be: coverage angles are Lisan Al Gaib only
body: Ziggy narrowed the scope in the Pent House room. The extra coverage angles are for Lisan Al Gaib only. Hon Dolo depends on ComfyUI, and we're still waiting on CFA Nova's proof of concept that he can be generated correctly there, so there's no Hon Dolo angle work for now. Lisan doesn't depend on ComfyUI. Please scope the list to Lisan: a full-body turnaround, profile, back, over-the-shoulder, hands/prop shots and partly obstructed frames for his priority scenes, with counts. Also tell us how to keep him recognizable when the throat worms and AL/GAIB marks are out of view. No generation until you decide.
